flask-static-catchall.python_justification: Flask 1.1.1 supports Python 2.7/3.5+ (setup.py python_requires: >=2.7, !=3.0-3.4). Python 3.8 is within supported range.

flask-json-datetime-tz.python_justification: Flask 0.12.2 supports Python 2.6/2.7/3.3-3.6 (setup.py classifiers). Python 3.6 is the latest version officially supported by this release.

python_pip_alignment.requirement: python and pip MUST refer to the same Python installation
python_pip_alignment.validation: python -m pip --version must show the same version as python --version
python_pip_alignment.note: Frozen Flask commands invoke bare `pip`. PATH must resolve pip to the same interpreter.

notes.windows_support: Windows is NOT an official benchmark execution platform. Windows may be used for: validate, plan, isolation-check, repository planning/development only.
notes.frozen_specs: Historical task commands (pip, tail, pnpm) are frozen and MUST NOT be rewritten for platform compatibility. The canonical environment MUST satisfy them.
